question: How should the breath be drawn in at the root of the tongue and palate to counteract time?
premises: The practice is located at the root of the tongue and palate.
The practitioner should take in the air.
The action should be done slowly.
inference: Therefore one should slowly draw in the breath at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Placing it at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the breath.
